snippet.title: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
INTERGALACTIC PUZZLE TOUCHDOWN now has a Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4648890/Intergalactic_Puzzle_Touchdown

Get ready for release on October 28th 2026 by wishlisting us today!

---

When mankind’s search for life among the stars leads alien societies to learn about THE BIG GAME, they begin the process of reshaping their society around the exciting game of FOOBAW. 

Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football.​​

- Strategic, turn-based PVP puzzling: Players alternate between Offense and Defense roles, attempting to outwit one another to make bigger matches and score more points.

- Go big with Big Plays: Large matches create powerful Big Play pieces, unlocking unpredictable offensive options to overcome your opponent’s Blockers.  

- Explore teams from across the galaxy: Find your favorite among the four stylish teams, each with their own unique Team Power to help you find an advantage.

- Risky play nets big rewards: Push your luck to try to skirt the game rules, but watch out for Penalties and Fumbles that could set your team back.

- Grow from rookie to veteran: Players can learn the ropes through a series of interactive in-game tutorials before diving into Quick Match to hone their skills.

- Built for tournament play: Fully networked multiplayer through Steam features both matchmaking and custom lobbies. Tournament organizers can also take advantage of built in spectating tools.
​
Game by NEST Interactive 2026
